title: The elder's line about the locked coffer ('Go hear what the dead king grieves over, up in the barrow. Then come back') repeated verbatim, word for word, on a second visit made after I had already fully heard the Hollow King's grief out in conversation at the throne; only later acquiring the unrelated king's seal item actually unlocked her real dialogue branch, with no signal that the seal (not the earlier conversation) was the real gate.
where: Elder's House / talk to elder -- the sealed coffer
